---
title: "Indium bump"
sidebar: get-started
---

`indium_bump` places one centered square indium bump, with an optional under-bump contact pad.

## Build the default component

~~~python
import gdsfactory as gf
import orcapen_sc_pdk

orcapen_sc_pdk.activate()
component = gf.get_component("indium_bump")
~~~

## Parameters

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `indium_bump_size` | 20 µm | Side length of the bump body. |
| `under_bump_size` | 40 µm | Side length of the under-bump contact pad. |
| `indium_bump_layer` | `LAYER.D0_D1_INDIUM_BUMP` | Bump-body layer. |
| `under_bump_layer` | `LAYER.D0_D1_UNDER_BUMP` | Contact-pad layer. |
| `include_under_bump` | `True` | Add the contact pad. |

## Ports and layers

The component has no ports. The default bump layer is indium with a nominal 8 µm stack thickness. The under-bump layer describes contact geometry and is excluded from simulation. Only the canonical bump-body layer receives a physical-stack entity; alternate body layers remain layout-only.

The [pinned public source](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/0bd9a9e1e8e21d6519f22373f20ef5ce22772a5b/orcapen_sc_pdk/cells/layout/indium.py) defines this factory.
